seoTitle: CSV Whitespace Trimmer: Trim and Collapse Spaces
metaDescription: Trim every cell and collapse tabs, repeated spaces and non-breaking spaces to single spaces in a CSV. Reports how many cells changed.
intro: Cleans invisible spacing problems in every cell: leading and trailing spaces, double spaces, tabs, non-breaking spaces and zero-width characters.
why:
Stray spaces cause failed joins, duplicate-looking rows and sorting surprises. Non-breaking spaces and zero-width characters look like nothing but are not equal to a normal space or to nothing.

The tool replaces all Unicode space separators with a plain space, optionally collapses runs, removes zero-width characters and trims each cell. The summary says how many cells changed so you can tell whether the data had a problem.
howTo: Choose whether to collapse internal runs and remove zero-width characters.
Copy or download the cleaned CSV.

faq.q: Does it change line breaks inside cells?
faq.a: Yes when collapsing: any whitespace run, including a line break, becomes one space.
Yes, header cells are cleaned too.
Regular space, tab, NBSP, the Unicode en/em spaces, narrow NBSP and ideographic space.
